---
  title: "PD1 percentage"
---
  
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)

files<-list.files("/media/Lawrenson_Lab_NAS/uthscsa/group_data/Xenium_labels/pembro",full.names = T)
files<-files[str_detect(files,"labels.gz")]
files<-files[str_detect(files,"UTP|Prime",negate = T)]

meta<-lapply(files,data.table::fread)
files<-str_remove_all(files,".+bro.|bnk.+")
names(meta)<-files
meta<-lapply(files,function(x) meta[[x]]%>%mutate(Section=x))%>%bind_rows()
meta<-meta%>%mutate(cell_id=paste0(Section,"_",cell))

coords<-data.table::fread("/media/Lawrenson_Lab_NAS/uthscsa/group_data/Xenium_labels/pembro/Banksy_domains.gz")
meta<-coords%>%select(cell_id,x_centroid,y_centroid,circle,Core_ID,responder)%>%inner_join(meta)

```

# Load expression data
```{r}
files<-list.files("/media/Xenium_On_NAS/xenium_reanalysis",full.names = T)
files<-files[str_detect(files,"Pro")]
files<-files[str_detect(files,"UTP",negate=T)]
xenium.list<-lapply(files, function(x) Read10X_h5(paste0(x,"/outs/cell_feature_matrix.h5")))
prote.list<-lapply(xenium.list,function(x) x$`Protein Expression`)
names(xenium.list)<-str_remove(files,".+sis.")
names(prote.list)<-str_remove(files,".+sis.")

prote.list<-lapply(prote.list,function(x) CreateSeuratObject(counts = x))
inteP<-merge(prote.list[[1]],y = prote.list[names(prote.list)[-1]],
            add.cell.ids =names(prote.list))
inteP<-subset(inteP,cells=meta$cell_id)
meta<-meta[order(match(meta$cell_id,colnames(inteP))),]
inteP<-AddMetaData(inteP,metadata = meta%>%column_to_rownames("cell_id"))
rm(prote.list)

inteP<-NormalizeData(inteP)
inteP<-ScaleData(inteP,features = rownames(inteP))
inteP<-RunPCA(inteP,features = rownames(inteP))
inteP<-IntegrateLayers(inteP,method = "HarmonyIntegration")
inteP[["RNA"]]<-JoinLayers(inteP[["RNA"]])

```

# Summary table
```{r}

temp<-inte@assays$RNA$data
temp<-temp%>%t()%>%as.data.frame()%>%rownames_to_column("cell_id")%>%
  inner_join(meta)
res<-temp%>%filter(PanCK>0)%>%count(Core_ID,name = "PanCKcells")
res<-temp%>%filter(`PD-1`>0)%>%count(Core_ID,name = "PD1cells")%>%inner_join(res)
res<-temp%>%filter(`PD-L1`>0)%>%count(Core_ID,name = "PDL1cells")%>%inner_join(res)
res<-temp%>%count(Core_ID,responder,name = "total")%>%inner_join(res)

p0<-res%>%filter(Core_ID%in%i)%>%mutate(cps=ifelse((PDL1cells/PanCKcells)>1,100,100*PDL1cells/PanCKcells),tumor=PanCKcells,across(PDL1cells:PanCKcells,function(x) 100*x/total))%>%ggplot(aes(x=PanCKcells,y=PD1cells,shape=responder,col=cps,size=tumor))+geom_point(alpha=.5)+geom_text_repel(aes(label=Core_ID))+labs(x="Cell %: PanCK > 0",y="Cell %: PD1 > 0")+scale_color_viridis_c(option = 'H')
p1<-res%>%filter(Core_ID%in%i)%>%mutate(cps=ifelse((PDL1cells/PanCKcells)>1,100,100*PDL1cells/PanCKcells),tumor=PanCKcells,across(PDL1cells:PanCKcells,function(x) 100*x/total))%>%ggplot(aes(x=PanCKcells,y=PDL1cells,shape=responder,col=cps,size=tumor))+geom_point(alpha=.5)+geom_text_repel(aes(label=Core_ID))+labs(x="Cell %: PanCK > 0",y="Cell %: PDL1 > 0")+scale_color_viridis_c(option = 'H')
p2<-res%>%filter(Core_ID%in%i)%>%mutate(cps=ifelse(PDL1cells/PanCKcells>1,100,100*PDL1cells/PanCKcells),tumor=PanCKcells,across(PDL1cells:PanCKcells,function(x) 100*x/total))%>%ggplot(aes(x=PD1cells,y=PDL1cells,shape=responder,col=cps,size=tumor))+geom_point(alpha=.5)+geom_text_repel(aes(label=Core_ID))+labs(x="Cell %: PD1 > 0",y="Cell %: PDL1 > 0")+scale_color_viridis_c(option = 'H')

```
